record.question: Which IP addresses are mostly used by web, email, and gaming servers?
record.explanation: For the conventional stable server-endpoint configuration tested here, a static IP is the best supplied choice: a fixed address supports predictable reachability and DNS/firewall configuration. Precision note: servers can also use dynamic addressing, load balancers or dynamic DNS; this is not a measured universal majority claim or a requirement that every physical backend have an immutable public address. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026. References: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-network/ip-services/public-ip-addresses
